subject: Add AIC8800 WiFi/BT driver.
author: Sorgelig

upstream.vanilla_quote: absent -- there is no aic8800 driver in any vanilla tree checked. Case-insensitive grep for aic8800 / aicwf / AICSemi / RivieraWaves / rwnx over drivers/, net/ and MAINTAINERS returns ZERO files in all three: torvalds/linux v7.3-rc2 (50d05c7c76c96b90462f24debacca971d2e86713; Makefile VERSION=7 PATCHLEVEL=3 EXTRAVERSION=-rc2), linux-6.18.y at 6.18.49 (release commit 1c732c6b94f0faee1526bd375add2fe10cba2e26) and linux-7.2.y at 7.2.3 (58e7295cfecaddec94629160386412e0f2b1e8fe). `find` for any filename containing those strings is likewise empty in all three. Nothing to quote because nothing exists.

provenance_doc_ref: none -- this commit is four days old and post-dates docs/patch-provenance.md's baseline entirely. Dispositioned here first.

impact.effect_if_absent: A USB dongle built on the AICSemi AIC8800 family (AIC8800 / 8801 / 8800DC / 8800DW / 8800DE / 8800D80 / 8800D80X2 / 8800D80N / 8800DLN / 8800M80 and the Tenda- and TP-Link-branded variants of them) binds no driver at all on our image: mainline 6.18/7.2/7.3-rc has no aic8800 driver over any bus, so there is no fallback. No wlanN appears, no hci for the BT half. Nothing logs an error beyond the usual 'no driver' -- the dongle simply does nothing. NOTE the symmetric fact: on the STOCK image, where the driver IS built (MiSTer_defconfig CONFIG_AIC8800_WLAN_SUPPORT=m + CONFIG_AIC_LOADFW_SUPPORT=m), the dongle also does nothing today, because Release 20260907's firmware.tar.gz ships 0 of the ~60 firmware blobs the driver filp_open()s from /lib/firmware (104 entries, zero aic/fmacfw/fw_patch/fw_adid/8800 matches; sha256 8a6ab6730e5a4b0ee978cae98a15fd8505e5605074cd34018adac0ac43359f78). So absence costs nothing that stock currently delivers.
affected_hardware: Tenda U2 (2604:0014), Tenda U11 (2604:001f), Tenda U11 Pro (2604:0020), Tenda (2604:0013) -- commodity Wi-Fi 6 USB dongles

AICSemi reference/OEM AIC8800 family under VIDs a69c and 368b (chips AIC8800, 8801, 8800DC, 8800DW, 8800DE, 8800D40/D41, 8800D80/D81, 8800D80X2/D81X2/D89X2, 8800D80N/D40N/DLN/DWN, 8800M80 customer variants, 8800FC customer variants)

userspace_coupling.main_mister_ref: absent -- grep -rniE 'aic8800|aicwf|a69c|368b|2604|0x8d81|/lib/firmware' over Main_MiSTer at 6cda9cc546c4b32e256a19931128b82586253812 returns exactly one hit and it is a false positive: support/atari8bit/atari800.cpp:838 '#define AU_FULL_ROTATION 26042'. forward_port.conflicts: none as a PATCH would be irrelevant -- it must not be carried as a patch at all (ADR 0016 + PLAN 2.9: a 82k-line entry in board/mister/de10nano/linux-patches/ would make scripts/export-kernel-tree.sh's per-patch replay and scripts/lint-kernel-patches.sh meaningless). forward_port.effort: Compiled and modpost-linked, not predicted. Against a configured 6.18.49 O= tree (our board/mister/de10nano/linux.config after olddefconfig, ARCH=arm LLVM=1): aic8800_fdrv 36/36 objects, 0 errors, 4 clang warnings (rwnx_msg_tx.c:4257 misleading-indentation; rwnx_tx.c:1471 'msgbuf' uninitialized; aic_priv_cmd.c:324 'lvl_mod' sometimes-uninitialized; aicwf_usb.c:1821 'buf_align' sometimes-uninitialized), LD [M] OK in 14 s. aic_load_fw 9/9 objects, 0 warnings, 0 errors, LD [M] OK. MODPOST: ran for real against an 11,372-line Module.symvers produced by building the kernel proper (make vmlinux + make modules; note that prepare/modules_prepare do NOT produce one). aic_load_fw.ko: exit 0, ZERO modpost errors, ZERO warnings. aic8800_fdrv.ko standalone: exactly 9 modpost errors and NOT ONE of them is a kernel symbol -- all nine are aic_load_fw's own EXPORT_SYMBOLs (get_userconfig_txpwr_idx, get_userconfig_txpwr_ofst, get_testmode, get_fw_path, aicwf_prealloc_txq_alloc, set_testmode, get_flash_bin_size, get_flash_bin_crc, get_adap_test). Re-run with KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS=<src>/aic_load_fw/Module.symvers: exit 0, ZERO errors, ZERO warnings, aic8800_fdrv.ko linked. So BOTH modules link clean against 6.18.49 for 32-bit ARM. BUILD-TIME SETTINGS REQUIRED: (a) CONFIG_AIC8800_WLAN_SUPPORT=m and CONFIG_AIC_LOADFW_SUPPORT=m on the kbuild command line -- aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:175 'obj-$(CONFIG_AIC8800_WLAN_SUPPORT) := $(MODULE_NAME).o' is never set by the file itself, the same trap every rtl* kernel-module package here documents; (b) two ordered M= passes with KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS, which does NOT fit pkg-kernel-module.mk's single M= and needs custom _BUILD_CMDS -- this is the one genuine kbuild quirk of this driver, the analogue of rtl8852cu's KSRC=. NO KSRC= override is needed here: aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:1 is already 'ccflags-y += $(USER_EXTRA_CFLAGS)' and every flag line is ccflags-*; there is no hard-coded KDIR, no host-kernel probe and no top-level modules: target. The 360-line fdrv Makefile is a flat feature-switch list (lines 5-138 + ccflags at 227-359), not a platform maze; its only ifdefs are two branches on CONFIG_ARCH_SUN60IW2P1 (Allwinner), both taking the else arm for us.

license_provenance: AICSemi re-badge of the RivieraWaves 'rwnx' fullmac cfg80211 driver. rwnx_main.c:69-71 declares RW_DRV_DESCRIPTION "RivieraWaves 11nac driver for Linux cfg80211" / RW_DRV_COPYRIGHT "Copyright(c) 2015-2017 RivieraWaves" / RW_DRV_AUTHOR "RivieraWaves S.A.S"; aic_load_fw/aic_bluetooth_main.c:13-16 declares DRV_DESCRIPTION "AIC BLUETOOTH" / DRV_COPYRIGHT "Copyright(c) 2015-2020 AICSemi". EXACT SNAPSHOT STAMP (the string to grep public trees for; both copies of rwnx_version_gen.h are identical): RWNX_VERS_REV "1a4b0054d2M (master)", RWNX_VERS_MOD "6.4.3.0", RELEASE_DATE "2026_0123_5f7be68d" -- i.e. AICSemi SDK v6.4.3.0 generated from vendor commit 1a4b0054d2 on master WITH UNCOMMITTED LOCAL CHANGES (the trailing 'M'). No README, no LICENSE, no build script, no .md/.txt of any kind anywhere in the 139 files; the upstream repository is NOT identifiable from the tree alone and was NOT cloned (no network per the preamble). LICENSE SWEEP over the 139 files under drivers/net/wireless/aic8800/: 1 file with an SPDX tag (aic_zlp_quirk/aic_zlp_quirk.c:1 '// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0' -- and that file is a THIRD origin again, MODULE_AUTHOR("Shen Mintao <cx330.shen@autocore.ai>"), a kprobes ZLP workaround); 0 files carrying a GPL licence NOTICE ('GNU General Public License' text appears nowhere); 3 MODULE_LICENSE declarations, all "GPL" (rwnx_main.c:9619, aic_bluetooth_main.c:82, aic_zlp_quirk.c:230); 85 files with only a bare Copyright line and NO licence grant; 51 files with neither a copyright line nor any licence. NON-GPL WORDING FOUND: aic8800_fdrv/aic_br_ext.c and aic_br_ext.h (1,686 lines) are 'Copyright (C) 2019-2021 Aicsemi Corporation / Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0' -- Apache-2.0 is GPL-2.0-only INCOMPATIBLE. Mitigating: aic_br_ext.o is not compiled (aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:85 CONFIG_BR_SUPPORT = n gating Makefile:209), so the built .ko contains no Apache code, but the files would be in any source tarball we redistribute. Copyright holders by header frequency: RivieraWaves (58 files across 2009-2019 ranges), AICSemi/Aicsemi/AIC semiconductor (21), Neratec Solutions AG (1, rwnx_radar.c:9, the DFS pattern detector), AutoCore.ai (1, the zlp quirk). NO binary blobs or firmware images are embedded: `file` over all 139 files reports zero non-text files; the largest hex concentrations are named PHY register tables in C (aicwf_compat_8800dc.c:270 'uint32_t ldpc_cfg_ram[] = {' and :947 'uint32_t agc_cfg_ram[] = {'). CONSEQUENCE FOR PACKAGING: there is no file for a Buildroot _LICENSE_FILES to name (contrast package/rtl8852cu-morrownr, LICENSE + its sha256 821deb3a... in the .hash), so a package must either pin an upstream repo that carries one or declare GPL-2.0 on the strength of three MODULE_LICENSE macros with a comment saying exactly that.
notes:
OWNER DECISION ITEM. Full analysis and the options table: docs/kernel-recon/fork-sync-2026-09/memo-Q9-aic8800.md. Disposition is not-evaluated as of owner decision D2=defer, 2026-09-11 (it was needs-verification through Waves 1-2; see the 'DEFERRED by owner decision D2' paragraph at the end of these notes for why not-evaluated is the accurate schema value for 'fully investigated, decision deferred on two named external unknowns'). Everything a source tree can answer has been answered (mainline absence, licence sweep, firmware inventory, USB-ID bind-conflict test, kconfig fit, and a real 32-bit-ARM compile); what remains needs either the network or the owner. Memo recommendation: DEFER (option D). MEMO'S SINGLE STRONGEST REASON: a package built today ships a module that cannot bring up an interface -- the driver filp_open()s ~60 firmware blobs from /lib/firmware and stock's Release 20260907 firmware.tar.gz contains 0 of 104 entries matching them, with no firmware commit anywhere in the fork's history (git log --all -i --grep=aic returns only this commit).

ADR 0016 ADMISSIBILITY: SATISFIED. Mainline cannot drive this chip over any bus at v7.3-rc2, 6.18.49 or 7.2.3 (see upstream.vanilla_quote). This is the same ground on which package/rtl8852cu-morrownr was accepted -- but stronger and weaker at once: stronger because rtw89 at least had the RTL8852C chip HAL and lacked only the USB bus file, whereas for AIC8800 mainline has nothing at all (no HAL, no staging entry, no MAINTAINERS line), so 'wait for mainline' has no visible horizon; weaker because rtl8852cu's firmware is welded into the driver as a C array and this driver's is not.

ADR 0016 BIND-CONFLICT TEST: PASSED, 0 overlaps. 46 unique VID:PIDs (41 from aic8800_fdrv/aicwf_usb.c:2643-2683 -- the CONFIG_USB_BT=y branch, which aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:68 selects -- plus 11 from aic_load_fw/aicwf_usb.c:1848-1858 plus 368b:8d81 hard-coded in aic_zlp_quirk.c:13-14) were grepped one by one against drivers/net/wireless/, drivers/bluetooth/, drivers/usb/ and drivers/net/usb/ at 6.18.49: checked=46 overlaps=0. Vendor-level, 0x368b has zero occurrences in wireless+bluetooth and the single 0xa69c hit is a coefficient in realtek/rtw89/rtw8852b_table.c:13964, not a USB ID. NEAR MISSES worth recording: rtw88/rtw8812au.c:76 claims 2604:0012, one PID below the Tenda block; rtw89/rtw8851bu.c:23 and bluetooth/btusb.c:528 both claim 3625:010b against our 3625:0110. INTERNAL overlap does exist and is by design (two-stage bring-up): a69c:8801, a69c:8d41, a69c:8d81, 368b:8d81, 368b:8d91 and 368b:8d99 appear in BOTH aic module tables, disambiguated only by aic8800_fdrv using USB_DEVICE_AND_INTERFACE_INFO(...,0xff,0xff,0xff) for three of them while aic_load_fw uses plain USB_DEVICE -- a hardware check, not a source check.

BUILD RESULT (the decisive evidence; the rtl8852cu lesson was that this must be compiled, not predicted): IT BUILDS AND IT MODPOSTS CLEAN. Both aic_load_fw.ko and aic8800_fdrv.ko link with zero modpost errors and zero modpost warnings against a real 11,372-line Module.symvers from 6.18.49 built for ARCH=arm LLVM=1. The only modpost failure seen anywhere was aic8800_fdrv built ALONE, which reports exactly 9 undefined symbols, every one of them an aic_load_fw EXPORT_SYMBOL and not one of them a kernel symbol; adding KBUILD_EXTRA_SYMBOLS=<src>/aic_load_fw/Module.symvers clears it completely. That is a packaging constraint (two ordered M= passes; pkg-kernel-module.mk issues a single M=), not a porting defect. See forward_port.effort for the object counts and warnings. THE __aeabi_uldivmod TRAP DOES NOT RECUR: llvm-nm -u over the linked objects finds 235 undefined symbols in aic8800_fdrv.o and 75 in aic_load_fw.o; the only libgcc/EABI helpers referenced anywhere are __aeabi_idiv and __aeabi_uidiv (fdrv only), and BOTH are exported to modules by arch/arm/kernel/armksyms.c:135 and :141 under '#ifdef CONFIG_AEABI' (:134), with CONFIG_AEABI=y in our resolved config. __aeabi_uldivmod -- the 64-bit helper that killed rtl8852cu at modpost and required package/rtl8852cu-morrownr/0001-mac_ax-use-div_u64-....patch -- is not referenced by this driver and has no EXPORT_SYMBOL anywhere in arch/arm/. So ADR 0016's FOURTH cost does not apply here and there is no standing per-bump re-check to inherit. Module deps from the same dump: aic8800_fdrv needs 9 symbols from aic_load_fw (get_fw_path, get_testmode, set_testmode, get_adap_test, get_flash_bin_size, get_flash_bin_crc, get_userconfig_txpwr_idx, get_userconfig_txpwr_ofst, aicwf_prealloc_txq_alloc) and 41 cfg80211_*/ieee80211_* symbols, so load order is cfg80211 -> aic_load_fw -> aic8800_fdrv and the two modules must ship together. MEASURED IMAGE COST (real .ko files, not an estimate): aic8800_fdrv.ko 9,434,308 B as linked -> 755,344 B after --strip-debug -> 177,816 B as .ko.xz; aic_load_fw.ko 1,389,572 -> 93,292 -> 29,012 B. TOTAL 206,828 B (~202 KiB) of .ko.xz for both modules -- about one NINTH of rtl8852cu-morrownr's 1.8 MB .ko.xz, precisely because the firmware is NOT linked in. The firmware package, if one is ever built, will dominate this line item entirely (~60 blobs, unmeasured).

HYPOTHESIS REFUTATIONS (PLAN 2.9). (1) 'our kernel does not enable CFG80211_WEXT (select-only symbol)' is WRONG for this config: board/mister/de10nano/linux.config:145 writes CONFIG_CFG80211_WEXT=y and it resolves (CONFIG_WEXT_CORE=y, CONFIG_WEXT_PROC=y), and CFG80211_WEXT is a PROMPTED bool in 6.18 (net/wireless/Kconfig:187-192), not select-only. The select-only symbol is CONFIG_WIRELESS_EXT (net/wireless/Kconfig:2-3, a bare prompt-less bool) and THAT is what stays unset -- which happens to be exactly the symbol the vendor Makefile keys on, so the PLAN's CONCLUSION (the wext shim compiles out cleanly) is right by a different route: aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:140-142 'ifneq ($(CONFIG_WIRELESS_EXT), y) / CONFIG_USE_WIRELESS_EXT = n / endif' drops aicwf_wext_linux.o (Makefile:224) and the -DCONFIG_USE_WIRELESS_EXT define (Makefile:348); all 15 in-source uses are #ifdef CONFIG_USE_WIRELESS_EXT including the only 'ndev->wireless_handlers =' at rwnx_main.c:2030. VERIFIED by the build: aicwf_wext_linux.o is not among the 36 objects. (2) '143 files, approx 70k lines' -- it is 142 files and 82,330 insertions (git show --numstat). (3) 'FW_NAME "fw.bin" plus per-chip files' understates it: ~60 .bin blobs plus ~13 .txt/.ini config files, 80 distinct filename literals in total, and the loader does NOT use request_firmware() in the compiled configuration -- CONFIG_USE_FW_REQUEST is ?=n in both Makefiles (aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:112, aic_load_fw/Makefile:15), so the path taken is filp_open() on a self-built path (rwnx_platform.c:674-691). Base directory is /lib/firmware because aic_load_fw/Makefile:26 sets CONFIG_PLATFORM_UBUNTU ?= y, selecting aicbluetooth.c:147 'static const char* aic_default_fw_path = "/lib/firmware";' over the Android /vendor/etc/firmware at :149; fdrv obtains it from aic_load_fw via the exported get_fw_path() (rwnx_utils.c:19,35). Subdirectories: /lib/firmware/{aic8800,aic8800D80,aic8800D80X2}/<name> for aic_load_fw (aicbluetooth.c:326-330), flat /lib/firmware/<name> for fdrv, and /lib/firmware/aic8800DC/<name> for 8800DC/DW (rwnx_platform.c:1672). Overridable via the aic_fw_path module parameter (aicbluetooth.c:152, mode 0660).

OTHER CONFIG FINDINGS. CONFIG_AIC_ZLP_QUIRK is NOT set in the fork defconfig and is unbuildable for us: it depends on KPROBES (aic8800/Kconfig:11-17) and '# CONFIG_KPROBES is not set' in BOTH the fork defconfig (MiSTer_defconfig:568) and ours -- dead code on both sides, droppable from any packaging. A REAL TRAP for a package: aic8800_fdrv/Makefile:104 is 'CONFIG_DEBUG_FS ?= n', a conditional assignment against a genuine kernel symbol that kbuild has already set to y from our .config, so the ?= does nothing and rwnx_debugfs.o (2,738 lines) + rwnx_fw_trace.o ARE built (both confirmed present in the 36-object list). Feature switches set inside the Makefile regardless of our kconfig: USE_5G=y (:64), COEX=y (:74), USB_BT=y (:68, this is what selects the 41-entry ID table), RWNX_RADAR=y (:158), BR_SUPPORT=n (:85, why the Apache files are not compiled), SDIO_SUPPORT=n (:60); the HE/VHT/WPA3 'FOR_OLD_KERNEL' shims are all n (:70-72), correct on 6.18 where cfg80211 has those natively. Platform switches CONFIG_PLATFORM_{ROCKCHIP,ALLWINNER,AMLOGIC,HI} are all ?=n (aic_load_fw/Makefile:22-25) so the rockchip_wifi_get_oob_irq() call at aicwf_usb.c:2268 and the Allwinner branches at rwnx_platform.c:925,1045,1592 and in aicwf_sdio.c do not compile; ANDROID_PLATFORM is never defined.

FORWARD-PORTING PROVENANCE, which matters for identifying upstream: the tree carries LINUX_VERSION_CODE guards up to KERNEL_VERSION(7, 2, 0) -- e.g. rwnx_tdls.c:118 and rwnx_main.c:2945,2957,3069 are '>= KERNEL_VERSION(7, 1, 0)' and rwnx_rx.c:1651 is '<= KERNEL_VERSION(6, 18, 0)'. A 2026-01-23 SDK stamp cannot have anticipated 7.1/7.2, so someone (the vendor since, an intermediate SBC tree, or Sorgelig) forward-ported it. That work is why the build succeeds and it is a strong hint that the upstream pin, once found, is recent.

GROUNDING GAP (env.md): every 6.18 quote here is from 6.18.49 (release commit 1c732c6b94f0faee1526bd375add2fe10cba2e26, linux-6.18.y) not the 6.18.50 the image pins, and every 7.x quote is from 7.2.3 (58e7295cfeca) not 7.2.4 -- the gregkh mirror lags one release and kernel.org is blocked.
